title: Florida Spaceport Improvement Program — Phase 65 Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Florida Space Coast authority and mission delivery reporting pack. FDOT's Spaceport Improvement Program describes a state capital channel administered with Space Florida and reports 48 funded infrastructure projects across the program.
key_findings: Florida maintains a dedicated state capital-improvement channel for spaceport infrastructure.
The program page reports 48 funded capital infrastructure projects.
The aggregate count does not identify current status, cost, contract, completion, acceptance, or utilization for every project.
why_it_matters: Which records connect licences, operators, infrastructure capital, construction, accepted facilities, mission use, safety, and repeat operations? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The program adds a state capital layer between Space Coast plans and the named assets needed for operations.
ftfn_relevance: Connects Florida policy to a recurring infrastructure funding channel.
Creates a discovery rail for project-level award and delivery records.
Supports comparison of plan, capital, build, acceptance, and use.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The project-count statement was not independently reconstructed from project-level records in this collection.
Program participation is not a contract award, completed asset, or operating result.
Current appropriations, schedules, scope, acceptance, and utilization require named records.
